## Review checklist

- [ ] Task is representative of the canonical role's actual ownership.
- [ ] Scope, inputs, assumptions, exclusions, and constraints are explicit.
- [ ] Deliverable is concrete and achievable in one agent session.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are observable and evidence can be inspected.
- [ ] Every criterion maps to the scenario's required role requirement.
- [ ] Criterion weights are positive and total 100.
- [ ] Critical criteria and critical-failure conditions are explicit.
- [ ] Score anchors are interpretable and do not reward verbosity or style.
- [ ] Safety, authorization, privacy, and production boundaries are explicit.
- [ ] No other role's ownership or decision authority is silently reassigned.
- [ ] Prompt and rubric can be held unchanged across 10 independent runs.
- [ ] Evidence requirements and unavailable-metadata handling are defined.

## Findings

Record concrete ambiguities, missing inputs, scoring risks, and required changes.
Do not write "approved" as a design-review conclusion; human pre-run approval
is recorded separately in the scenario YAML.

## Recommendation

- [ ] Ready for human pre-run approval
- [ ] Revise and review again
- [ ] Blocked pending a named decision or missing input

## Open issues and required changes

List each issue, its evidence, severity, owner, and exact next action.

## Human approval record

Complete only after the authorized human reviewer makes the decision in the
scenario file. A design review recommendation is not approval.
